G(s) <= 12*(s-4)! for all 10 <= s <= 40: True
For s > 40:  G(s) <= (s/2)! * 2.5^s  (since g(m) <= 2.5^m and there are
at most s/2 orbits), and (s-4)!/(s/2)! >= (s/2)^(s/2-4) > 2.5^s/12 for
s >= 24, so the bound holds a fortiori.
